label: A New Phantom Thief Crew: A

lines.text: At long last, it's break time.

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: Haa... W-we finally get to rest...!

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: That was a thousand times harder than PE!

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: She really is an excellent instructor.

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: I learned a great deal from her... Though I am exhausted.
Yukiko and Queen slump to the ground,
watching the Nikkes continue their extra training.

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: Still, it looks like she went a little easy on us.

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: Yeah... Aigis seems to be keeping up just fine.

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: Aren't you getting tired, Commander?
*Huff...* I'm... not tired...

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: R-right...

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: I'm... *huff...* not tired either... I can... still... keep going...!

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: You're all covered in dirt...

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: Still, this training really is effective. Maybe I'll recommend it to everyone when we get back to our world.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Great job, everyone.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: W-we brought you something to drink... and some snacks...
They hand out snacks during breaks now?
Things have really changed...

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: What was it like when you went through training, Commander?
Back in my day...!
Ahem.
I'd better stop there before this starts getting weird.

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: Hahaha, you sound like such an old man.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: W-we don't normally hand these out...

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: B-but Eunhwa told me to make sure you got one...

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: Is she secretly a tsundere?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Hehe, you could say that.
She may seem strict, but she pays close attention to each and every one of you.
I take a cookie out of the basket.
That's what makes her such an excellent instructor.

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: I see...

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: She certainly seems to be an excellent instructor.

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: I dunno... The look in her eyes was terrifying...

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: I can't bear it...

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I baked those cookies myself. Enjoy!
Wait! Everyone, get away from the...

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: Wow, really?

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: Do you like to cook, Emma-san?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Yeah, I love it.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I make all the meals for my squad.

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: I see. Actually, I made dinner for everyone last night...
Wait, hear me out...

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: Heehee! I'm gonna gobble up every last cookie!

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: Hey! Save some for the rest of us!
*Munch, munch, munch*

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: ... He really didn't leave us any.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Hehe. Don't worry, there's plenty more. I'll bring you some during your next break.

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: Commander, you can have Emma-chan's cookies anytime, right? So this time, let me have 'em!
Get some rest, Teddie.
Just then, the Thieves of Justice and Aigis come over after wrapping up their extra training.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: You all did great!

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: You must be exhausted.
*Thud*

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: Bleurgh...

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: Teddie?! What's wrong?!
I lay Teddie, who'd collapsed after ingesting a large amount of poison, in the shade before heading back.

lines.speaker: ce009_03
lines.text: It was highly productive. I acquired detailed data on Nikke training.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Man, I'm exhausted...

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: But you kept up with that training no problem, Aigis. You're really tough.

lines.speaker: ce009_03
lines.text: Yes, I was created as an anti-Shadow weapon.

lines.speaker: ce009_03
lines.text: I'm a bit different from you Nikkes, but I'm equipped with durable armor and ample firepower.

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: You're right. You can tell this world is different from ours just by looking at the tools people use.

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: ... Technology really has come a long way. Take the Ark's sky, for example. If you hadn't told me it was artificial, I never would've guessed.

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: I had no idea we were underground until you pointed it out, either. It's just one surprise after another...

lines.speaker: ce009_03
lines.text: Your technology is certainly impressive. Nikkes, in particular... Flexible bodies capable of wielding such high-output weaponry.

lines.speaker: ce009_03
lines.text: Even so, you're no different from the humans I know. Not only in appearance, but in the way you speak and behave as well.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Indeed. We were created out of necessity,

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: but we were once human.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: As I mentioned before, we're bound by all manner of restrictions, one of which is that we must remain as human as possible.

lines.speaker: ce009_03
lines.text: Since you were originally human, I believe it is reasonable to conclude that you possess human emotions and a heart.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Heh, I guess you could think of it that way.
I think so too.
What matters is how you see yourself.
Even if your body is a machine, if you believe you're human, then your heart becomes human too.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: That's correct.
Phantom looks over the group.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Humans, Nikkes, humanoid weapons, bears...

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: and... well...

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: What am I to call you, if not a cat?

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: Of course I'm human! I just happen to look a little different from Queen and the Commander, that's all...

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: I see. You have your own idea of what makes someone human. In that case, Mona is human too.

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: Well... Thanks...

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Haha, that's as it should be.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: We're all doing our utmost to defeat the villains

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: because it's the right thing to do.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: It's a truly fitting way for phantom thieves to conduct themselves.

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: Um... Is it okay that I'm not a phantom thief?

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: Th-that's a good point. Mona and I are phantom thieves ourselves, but that's a little different from the kind of "phantom thief" you're talking about...

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Oh, is that so? Could you explain how it's different?

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: What we steal are corrupted hearts.

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: We take them from adults consumed by distorted desires. In other words... bad people.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: So you steal hearts... How very romantic.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Then I suppose you're the Phantom Thieves of Hearts?

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: Uh...

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: Huh...?

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Is something the matter?

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: I didn't think you'd figure it out so quickly.

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: Just as you said, we're the Phantom Thieves of Hearts.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Haha, is that so? That's quite a romantic name for a band of phantom thieves.

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: You call yourselves the Thieves of Justice, right?

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Indeed. It is our duty to uphold justice in the way of a phantom thief.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Isn't that right, Yukiko?

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: Huh? Me?!

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Though you hail from a different crew, Queen and Mona are already phantom thieves.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: You, Teddie, and Aigis have likewise grown into admirable phantom thieves who share our ideals.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: In other words, you're no ordinary people.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: If you are willing, I would be honored to welcome you into the Thieves of Justice.

lines.speaker: miranda_c
lines.text: We've got more members now!

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Not so fast. They haven't said they'll join us yet.

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: Woohoo! I did it! I'm a phantom thief now!

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: Wait... Teddie?!

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: Let's give it our bear-st as members of the Thieves of Justice!

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: We'll beat the bad guys and make our way back to our teachers!

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: Beat the bad guys...?

lines.speaker: ce009_03
lines.text: I belong to SEES. However, I agree with your way of thinking, Phantom-san.

lines.speaker: ce009_03
lines.text: Therefore, while I am in this world, I believe it is logical for me to join the Thieves of Justice.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Haha, that's kind of you to say.

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: Me too. I'll join too!

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: Let's do our best together!

lines.speaker: ce009_03
lines.text: Understood. I'll work with you as a phantom thief until I return to my own world.

lines.speaker: ce009_04
lines.text: Me too! This is great!

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Very well. Then, until you return to your own world,

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: we shall be... the Thieves of Judgment.

lines.speaker: miranda_c
lines.text: Huh? Am I supposed to referee or something?

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: No, no, it's not like we're suddenly holding a sporting event.

lines.speaker: ce009_05_1
lines.text: When Phantom says "judgment," she doesn't mean a referee...

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Oh, I get it! Hahaha, we're passing judgment on the bad guys, right?

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Indeed. We're not merely on the side of justice.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: It's time to pass judgment on those who seek to harm the Ark.
Phantom springs to her feet.
*Thud*
Then she slumps back to the ground.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: My apologies, my legs have given out after that grueling training.

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: Hehe, I guess that's to be expected. That training was really tough... Here, take my hand.

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: Looks like the training's about to start again.
Yukiko and Queen stand up and help Phantom to her feet.

lines.speaker: ce009_02
lines.text: Huh?!

lines.speaker: ce009_01_1
lines.text: You're so heavy...!

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: There's no need to worry. Combat bodies are naturally quite heavy.

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Had I come in my normal body as instructed, that could've ended very badly...

lines.speaker: phantom
lines.text: Oh dear.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: No wonder it looked so easy for you!
... Eunhwa.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: What?
Don't kill her.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: I'll try.
A short while later, we finally make it through the first day of training.
As I collapse to the ground to catch my breath, Eunhwa walks over.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Their basic stamina...

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: isn't bad, considering they're not Nikkes. Aigis is keeping up well, since she isn't human.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: If we stick to the training schedule, they'll at least be able to hold their own.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: The rest is up to your command.
Okay, thanks. Great work out there.
I'm counting on you tomorrow and the day after, too.
Eunhwa averts her gaze slightly.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: ... You did well too.
